ops.body: Two review notes from the 2026-07-26 helper-plist wave (synckit finder pass): (1) cookiesync's helper manifest sets SessionType Aqua specifically for Keychain/Touch-ID (cookiesync internal/cli/install.go:68, internal/cookie/consent.go); with session-type keys no longer materializing, the cutover must explicitly verify Touch-ID consent still works from a keyless gui/<uid> agent (expected fine — the local capt-hook GUI helper runs keyless today — but verify, not assume). (2) bundledExecutable() recognizes only Contents/MacOS/<exe>; helpers shipped from Contents/Helpers, Contents/Library/LoginItems, or embedded .appex/.xpc would be byte-staged and lose bundle identity — no current consumer resolves there, but the deployment-package adoption should own all bundle shapes.
